entries.name: On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Blade)
On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Magic)

system.description: The dense skeleton of a draugr.

A short range spell with superior accuracy that electrifies its victim with sparks of lightning. 

Extra Attack. Successful hits have a 25% chance of inflicting 1 extra Brk damage. No effect if the target is Protected from Lightning damage.
